# BB00369: Du'ay'i Istijari'l-'abd mina'n-nar {.unnumbered}

A Prayer for Protection from the Fire

In the Name of God, the Most Invincible, the Most Holy!

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! O Lord! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Mighty One, O Exalted One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Wondrous One, O Most High! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O All-Compelling One, O Holy One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Beloved One, O All-Glorious! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Self-Subsisting One, O Most Holy! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Inaccessible One, O Most Exalted! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Single One, O Self-Sufficient! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Peerless One, O Just One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Subduing One, O Manifest One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Unique One, O Equitable One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Bestower, O Munificent One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art, O Single One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O All-Hearing One, O Wondrous One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Worshipped One, O Desired One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O All-Knowing One, O All-Wise! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Succorer, O Help in Peril! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O All-Seeing One, O Subtle One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.

O my God! I beseech Thee, O Magnificent One, O Generous One! Through Thy bounty and generosity, protect me and those who believe in Thee and Thy verses from all fire, for verily Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.
